segments.name: Contract logistics
segments.description: Provides land-only transportation and contract logistics solutions to large institutional customers in China.
segments.evidence: As a result of the assessment made by CODM, the Group has only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Institutional customers pay the company under yearly contracts for logistics solutions covering industrial raw materials line-haul transportation.
revenueModel.evidence: A significant portion of our customers are large institutional customers, with whom we have maintained long-term relationship and typically enter into contracts for our provision of logistics solutions on a yearly basis.
